full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff's stated, inter alia, that Osman Ali transferred his entire share of S.A. Khatian No.539 with other land to his daughter by heba and delivered possession and in this way Shamima Khatun became owner of the suit land by inheritance, by heba and by settlement and constructed dwelling house thereon and used to possess by planting trees exclusively. Shamima's two sons inherited her property. Defendant Nos.2-8 fraudulently recorded the suit land in their names. Taking advantage of the wrong recording they created the false story of Settlement upon forged deeds on the basis of which Title Suit No.357 of 1973 was decreed ex parte on 09.03.1977, without impleading the plaintiffs.
